DK92.1 is a medical diagnosis code representing melena, a condition characterized by black, tarry stools that typically indicates upper gastrointestinal bleeding [^src1]. Within the context of the Danish national clinical quality database for [[atrieflimren|atrial fibrillation]], this code plays a specific and vital role in tracking patient outcomes and treatment complications [^src1]. Specifically, DK92.1 is utilized as one of the diagnostic codes to identify and calculate the incidence of [[alvorlig-bloedning|severe bleeding]] among patients being treated for atrial fibrillation [^src3]. 

The tracking of severe bleeding is a critical quality indicator in the management of atrial fibrillation, as these patients are frequently prescribed anticoagulants which inherently carry a risk of hemorrhage. To capture the full scope of this complication, the national registries employ a broad spectrum of diagnosis codes. For gastrointestinal bleeding alone, the clinical indicators utilize codes ranging from [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] to [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]], alongside [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]], which explicitly includes DK92.1 for melena [^src1]. This systematic coding ensures that healthcare quality and patient safety can be rigorously monitored, audited, and compared across different regions in the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. 

The definition and application of DK92.1 for this specific quality indicator have been consistently documented across multiple annual methodology reports from the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) and the Danish Healthcare Quality Institute, spanning from 2023 to 2025 [^src1] [^src2] [^src3].

## Claims
- **Diagnostic**: For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31) [^src1]
